name: region
title: Board region
description: The frame of one area of the board, an open frame with no fill (D-024): its title and decided count sit in a gap cut from the top border on the left; on the right the mode row (README pick 1, mockup 05): five layout icons, a divider and the settings cog. Hovering an icon or reaching the row by keyboard opens the layout popover; the cog opens the settings menu (Reset places). All drawn as one generic element whatever the mode. Cards and wires are drawn in their own layers (D-013), so the element is only the frame.

files.core: region-core.ts (regionState, regionNote, noteStage, noteBadge, commentLabel, NOTE_STAGE_TEXT, REGION_NOTE_EVENT, REGION_NOTE_RESIZE_EVENT, regionHolders, regionColour, REGION_COLOUR_DEFAULT, MODE_LABEL, MODE_HINT, agentChoiceText, RESET_NONE_HINT, PUT_BACK_NONE_HINT, RegionState, RegionNoteState, RegionNoteStage, RegionBadge, RegionNoteAction, RegionNoteEventDetail, RegionNoteResizeDetail, RegionHolder; no DOM)
files.preview: region-preview.ts (previewStep, previewShown, PREVIEW_CLOSED: when the note preview is open, WCAG 1.4.13; no DOM)
files.template: region-template.ts (regionTemplate, holdersTemplate, regionIds: the only places the markup is built)
files.icons: region-icons.ts (MODE_ICON per mode, COG_ICON, EYE_ICON; wrapped by the node pattern's svgIcon)
files.behaviour: region-row.ts (bindModeRow: the row's Tab stop and arrow keys, the popover and the settings menu; browser only); region-note.ts (bindNoteParts: Comment's badge, the note preview and the note block, their events and the block's height; browser only)
files.styles: region.css (scoped by the tag; tokens only; the top padding states REGION_HEAD from packages/layout)

flaggedStates.held: agentAccess flag: the region's holders after the count, the creator as plain text and every other holder as a Remove access button (D-027). Kept out of `states` so the gallery without the flag reads as before.

attributes.data-mode: grid | flow | lanes | radial | list: the layout in force (set by update)
attributes.data-open: modes | menu: the layout popover or the settings menu is open (set by the row behaviour); the frame is then drawn above the cards
attributes.data-drop: the frame is the drop target under a card dragged by its kind tab: a dashed accent line and a soft fill (set by the page, 3_FE_03 ruling 3)
attributes.data-fixed: the board sets the frame's layout (the built-in Later, 3_FE_03 ruling 5): no layout icons or popover, and no Comment, note preview or note block (Later takes no note); the grip and the cog stay (set by render)
attributes.data-dragging: the frame is being moved by its grip: grip dots shown, cursor grabbing, no transform transition (set by the page, 3_FE_04 ruling 6)
attributes.data-note-open: the container's note bubble is open: Comment drawn pressed; the preview closes (set by setNoteOpen)
attributes.data-badge: unsent | sent | none: Comment's badge "1", bright (accent) while unsent, quiet once sent and still waiting; none once answered (no badge drawn); absent with no note (set by update from RegionNoteState.badge; step 4G ruling 1)
attributes.data-note-stage: unsent | sent | answered: the latest note's stage, for the preview's and the block's state line and look; absent with no note (set by update). Not data-note, which the page's listener reads on cards
attributes.data-preview: the note preview is open under Comment; the frame is drawn above the cards like data-open (set by the note behaviour from previewShown)
attributes.data-note-shown: the note block shows under the title line (the noteShown property; page state only, not in the ledger, step 4G ruling 3). Set as an attribute it takes effect on the next update; the property applies at once
attributes.--region: the frame colour as a CSS value, from regionColour (set by render); the frame line, the title and the active icon mix from it
attributes.aria-labelledby: region-<id>, the heading inside the frame (set by render)

methods.render(r: Region, opts?: { fixed?, empty: once per view version: data-region, role, aria-labelledby, --region, innerHTML = regionTemplate(r, opts) (the popover foot names r.mode, the agent's choice); `fixed` leaves out the layout icons and popover and sets data-fixed, `empty` replaces the empty message; closes anything open
methods.update(st: RegionState): on every state change: attributes and text only (data-mode, the icons' aria-checked and the row's Tab stop, the current tile, count text, Reset places and Put container back aria-disabled and their hints, Comment's aria-label (st.commentLabel) and data-badge, data-note-stage, the preview's and the block's text, state line and buttons from st.note, the empty message), so focus survives; the holders slot is redrawn from holdersTemplate only when the holders change. regionState's 6th argument `owed` (container ids pendingItems lists) decides waiting vs answered for a sent note; left out, a sent note counts as waiting
methods.setNoteOpen(open): the container's note bubble opened or closed: data-note-open; opening closes the preview
methods.noteShown (property, boolean): show or hide the note block (reflects data-note-shown). The element never sets it itself: the page does, on a vb-region-note show or hide
methods.noteHeight(): number: the note block's height in the frame's own (unscaled) pixels, its gap to the cards included; 0 while hidden or with no note. The same number vb-region-note-resize carries; the page passes it to layout as the container's extra top inset (step 4G2)
methods.titleLine(): the title line element, whose box the page passes through the note bubble's titleAnchor to place the container's bubble
methods.showPanel(what, { mode?, focus? }): opens the layout popover with mode highlighted, or the settings menu (focusing its item unless focus is false); the gallery draws its open samples with it

events: button[role=radio][data-mode] click (pointer, Enter or Space) bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the mode action; the popover closes

mouse over a layout icon, or keyboard focus on one -> the popover opens with that layout highlighted and tied to the icon by aria-describedby; it closes on leaving the row and popover, on blur, Esc or a pick
Arrow keys move between the five layouts and the cog (one Tab stop for the row, roving tabindex); Home and End; ArrowDown on the cog opens its menu
cog click -> the settings menu opens and its item takes focus; Esc or a click outside closes it and focus returns to the cog; Tab closes it
menuitem[data-reset] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> unpin every node of the region; while aria-disabled (no card moved) the click is stopped in the element
menuitem[data-put-back] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> unpin the container (board + region); while aria-disabled (Not moved) the click is stopped in the element

button[data-region-comment] click (pointer, Enter or Space; a stop of the row between the layouts and the cog) bubbles to the page -> the container's note bubble opens (the preview closes). Touch: with a note, the first tap opens the preview instead and the click is stopped in the element; a tap on Comment while the preview is open goes through

mouse over Comment, or keyboard focus on it, with a note -> the preview opens; it stays while the pointer is over Comment or the preview and while focus is in either; it closes when both are left, on Esc (focus back on Comment), on a press outside (touch) and when the bubble opens

vb-region-note (bubbles, CustomEvent): detail { region, action: 'edit' | 'remove' | 'show' | 'hide', seq } from the preview's Edit (Open for a sent note) and Show in container / Hide, and the note block's Edit and Remove; seq is the latest note's. The page acts: edit opens the bubble, remove writes note-remove, show / hide set noteShown

vb-region-note-resize (bubbles, CustomEvent): detail { region, height } whenever the note block's height (noteHeight) changes: shown, hidden (0), Show all / Show less, new text, a width change (ResizeObserver)
.vb-nblock-more click -> Show all / Show less (inside the element: aria-expanded, then a vb-region-note-resize)
button.vb-region-grip: pointer drag and Alt+arrows are wired by the page (3_FE_04 rulings 5, 6, 8); a plain drag elsewhere on the title line still pans
button[data-revoke] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> confirm, then the revoke action for that holder (agentAccess flag)
whenToUse: The frame of every area of the board that has its own layout mode.
whenNotToUse: Lane bands and labels inside a region (the wires layer draws them until <vb-link> arrives); cards (<vb-node>).
narrow: Under 600px of frame (container query) the popover drops to compact tiles: icon and name, with the highlighted layout's one-liner on one line under them. The count gives way before the title. At the minimum frame (336px) about eight letters of title fit beside the row; a longer title ellipsizes.
accessibility: A labelled region landmark named by its heading. The layout icons are radios in a labelled radiogroup (one Tab stop, arrow keys between them, Enter or Space applies); the popover is a role=tooltip described onto the icon it is about. The cog is a menu button (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, aria-controls) for a labelled role=menu with two menuitems: Reset places, aria-disabled with a described hint (No cards moved) when there is nothing to reset, and Put container back, aria-disabled with a described hint (Not moved) when the container has no place of its own. The grip is a real button named "Move container <title>" with aria-keyshortcuts for Alt+arrows, always in the tab order (its dots show on hover and focus). Comment is a button named "Comment on container <title>" (aria-haspopup=dialog) in the row's roving Tab stop; its name says the badge (", 1 unsent note" or ", 1 sent note waiting for the agent"), and the badge itself is aria-hidden. While the preview is open Comment is aria-describedby its text. The preview is a non-modal role=dialog labelled "Note on container <title>" (not a tooltip: it holds buttons), placed right after the row so Tab from Comment reaches Edit and Show in container / Hide; Esc closes it and returns focus to Comment (WCAG 1.4.13: hoverable, persistent, dismissible). The note block is a role=group labelled "Note on container <title>" with named Edit and Remove buttons (unsent only) and a Show all / Show less button (aria-expanded, aria-controls the text). A removable holder is a real button named "<label>: remove access"; the creator is plain text.
far: Below FAR_K the stage carries data-zoom=far and the row hides (visibility), its popover and menu with it, like the cards' buttons (N8).
